verdicts.why: B's four pills are exactly the reader's own headings, with clean membership and full coverage, and they combine usefully. A has useful specifics (sourdough, kimchi, compost, seed saving) but four of its eleven pills are junk or near-duplicates (season, kitchen, harvest, tomatoes grown), several memberships rest on passing mentions, and it lacks the Fermentation and gardening umbrellas.

B is accurate but only splits the shelf into two halves that never intersect, which barely filters a 13-article shelf. A is noisy, but sourdough, kimchi, compost, seed saving, beekeeping and seasonal cooking are filters this reader would actually use.
A is B plus Soil health and Seasonal cooking, both real cross-cutting interests with sound membership, and they make two-pill narrowing useful. B's two disjoint pills offer no narrowing at all.
